# greenroom

> CLI, MCP server and library that rehearses a launch, pricing change or repositioning against simulated buyers built from real, verbatim quotes. Works on a Claude subscription (claude -p), any API key, or a local model. Bright Data is the optional grounding layer. Add your own customer text (tickets, survey comments) and segment sizes to get customers and revenue at risk. Results come as a median with a range across independent samples, with a confidence grade.

## Start here
- Operating guide for agents: run `npx -y greenroom-cli guide` (the MCP server sends the same text as its instructions)
- [README](https://github.com/danishashko/greenroom/blob/main/README.md): install, backends, time and cost, CLI, MCP, limits
- [Claude Code skill](https://github.com/danishashko/greenroom/blob/main/skills/greenroom/SKILL.md)
- [Example report: Unity Runtime Fee 2023 backtest](https://github.com/danishashko/greenroom/blob/main/examples/unity-2023/report.md)

## Interfaces
- CLI: `npx greenroom-cli run "<change>" --json`
- MCP: `npx -y greenroom-cli mcp` (tools: greenroom_doctor, greenroom_estimate, greenroom_start, greenroom_status, greenroom_report, greenroom_runs)
- Schemas: `greenroom schema report`, `greenroom schema seed`

## Optional
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/danishashko/greenroom/blob/main/AGENTS.md): for coding agents changing the repo
